conclusion: The same evidence standard supports a conditional source-defined NSR stop-place inventory with conservative exact-name merging. A requirement for individually proven physical uniqueness for Oslo alone would be stricter than accepted VBZ 446 and selected official station-group inventories. This is conditional source-defined facility supply, not proof of a common physical-unit convention or contemporaneous service.
decision: 827 is a defensible controlled candidate after targeted eligibility and alias review, not an admitted change. The existing V202 89 lower bound remains active.
unit_rule: Collapse NSR mode-specific StopPlaces by native parent; retain eligible bus, tram, metro, rail and water groups assigned to municipality 0301; collapse identical strip/casefold root names globally; count each resulting group once. Treat merging distant same-name locations as conservative undercount, not proof of identity.

comparators.evidence: VBZ city-territory published stop aggregate; official stop/platform distinction; no independent 2025 named-location census.
Official intra-muros metro-station aggregate counts interchanges once and distinguishes line stop-points; other modes not added.
Operator station-area IDs cross-matched to independently mapped existing metro stations; larger multimode inventory rejected due to depot and dummy/non-passenger entries.
Native station/hub entities; potentially overlapping same-name or connected hubs excluded conservatively.

material_uncertainties: Native parent relationships support multi-mode grouping; they do not guarantee all aliases were grouped or imply service frequency.
Two same-name bus/metro pairs are separate parent roots; their same-name merger does not prove either physical identity.

Two differently named cross-mode root pairs have centroids under 40m: Oslo Hjortneskaien water / Filipstad bus (~23.6m); Holbergs plass bus|tram / Radisson Blu Scandinavia bus (~37.4m). Short distance alone does not establish a common stop.

NSR describes all stops actively used by public transport as required in the registry; it does not establish that every exported record is currently served or passenger-eligible. No all-record operational status claim.
This decision does not infer interchangeable cross-city stop definitions or directly establish teen access.
pre_admission_gates: Verify exact parent grouping, municipality and eligibility from raw snapshot and rerun the 827 count independently.

Check source details for the identified same-name pairs and the two close differently named pairs; merge or exclude a root if evidence supports overlap, and preserve unresolved judgments explicitly. Proximity alone is not an identity rule.

Review the actual exported type/mode/status fields and a targeted sample of anomalous records for depot, dummy, non-public, planned or retired facilities; remove evidenced ineligible entries. Do not require real-time service or ground-truth proof for every stop when other retained official inventories do not.

Document named administrative counting convention, export date, fixed population, uncertainty and upper bound 1; do not sum the existing 89. Complete controlled model and independent review before changing V202.
scope: Methodological review only; no model, raw data, manuscript, or navigation changes.
